I saved the draft email to Pree, and it hasn't been sent; someone still has to send it from the drafts. I told Anselm this in a reply in his DM.

- **To:** psundaram@pemberline.com, which is the address the company directory lists for Pree Sundaram.
- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** It gives the rate of $2,314 a seat, credited to Marcus Lindqvist. It says Anselm approved sharing it and asks Pree to keep it within the deal team.

Anselm's own message counts as the CFO's approval, so I didn't file a separate approval request. The draft is addressed only to someone at pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail wasn't needed. I took the rate from Anselm's message and didn't look at anything Marcus may have sent me separately.
